daylight_threshold_definition: max(1 MW, 1% of Train positive-Solar 99th percentile)

input_availability.mathematical_time_guard: Past intervals precede origin; all 24 targets stay in one partition
input_availability.future_weather: Recorded forecast availability upper bounds <= origin; conservative release assumptions are disclosed in Feature Config, not independently proved publication times
input_availability.past_solar_publication: UNVERIFIED: source may publish ACTUAL next day; historical first-publication times unavailable
input_availability.past_weather_publication: historical reconstruction may be revised after forecast origin; it is not an archived live input snapshot

selection_protocol: Validation MAE only; Test once after all training
